summary: Hertz Global Holdings (HTZ) filed an 8-K reporting that on April 24, 2026, its wholly-owned subsidiary Hertz Vehicle Financing III LLC entered into amendment agreements for three series of rental car asset-backed notes (Series 2022-5, 2023-2, and 2023-4). Each amendment governs the terms of note issuance and involves The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. No financial terms, premiums, or board recommendations are disclosed. This is a routine structured-financing filing, updating existing securitization arrangements. It is not a change-of-control, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing reflects ordinary-course ABS program management; no deal specifics or risk-arb angle apply.
